name: @rascaltwo/pairwise-sorter
description: Rank anything by answering "which is better?" one pair at a time — a logic core and web components.

scripts.prepare: if command -v tsc >/dev/null; then tsc -p tsconfig.build.json; else bunx -p typescript@5 tsc -p tsconfig.build.json; fi
scripts.docs:publish: bun run docs:dev && bun "${VIZ_SKILL_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/skills/viz}/viz.ts" publish viz-pages --out .viz-publish --no-index --no-og --no-deploy-notice && cp .viz-publish/pairwise-sorter/index.html pages/index.html
scripts.site: bun run build && bun run docs && cp -R pages/. site/ && cp -R dist site/dist
